purpose: Construct and independently audit an explicit variable-cardinality constraint-native CQM on the frozen Stage72 receptor-selection objective, then compare matched-budget joint classical and hardware-shaped local samplers without cloud or quantum-hardware execution.

variable_k_cqm.candidate_objective: For reward rho, minimize sum_(i<j) (r_ij-rho) x_i x_j.
variable_k_cqm.one_hot_constraint: sum_k y_k = 1 over the frozen Stage74 candidate k values.
variable_k_cqm.conditional_quality_constraint: sum_i deficit_i*x_i <= sum_k D_k*y_k, where D_k is the Stage74 balanced-10pct integer quality threshold.
variable_k_cqm.reward_rule: Use deterministic order statistics of the frozen raw pair coefficients at the listed quantiles.

solver_protocol.initialization_rule: Draw a candidate k uniformly and then a uniform fixed-k subset until the selected conditional quality threshold is met; use the deterministic minimum-deficit fallback only after the frozen maximum attempts.
solver_protocol.variable_k_neighborhood: With probability 0.7 use a one-out one-in swap; otherwise draw a different allowed k and a random subset at that cardinality. Reject conditional-quality violations before objective evaluation.
solver_protocol.decision_metric: Use normalized objective gaps and matched proposal budgets; exclude wall-clock runtime from route decisions.

benchmark_gate.interpretation: Encoding, exact-small-cell fidelity, and sampler competitiveness authorize only a frozen explicit variable-k CQM and local hardware-shaped emulation. They do not authorize paid cloud execution, QPU execution, quantum scaling, or quantum advantage claims.

interpretation_boundary: Stage75 is a post-hoc optimization and encoding study on four consumed historical development targets. It does not estimate a biologically optimal receptor count, test screening efficacy, validate a new target, certify global optima for Stage74 cells above the exact-enumeration limit, measure physical embedding, execute a paid hybrid or QPU solver, establish quantum scaling, or demonstrate quantum advantage.
